race.comment: BOOYA BOY (7) is the one to beat after two strong runs, most recently finishing just under a length in a BM55 at Dalby as the favourite despite an awkward start. His sixth at Gold Coast is also respectable, as he was held up from the 300m and had interference late, indicating he has more to give. KIRKSVILLE (1) is a key threat, coming off a win in a BM62 at this track and placing in a BM65 here first-up. His track-and-distance record supports him despite the big weight. JUST PLAIN NUTS (2) has a different angle, coming across from Tassie after a CL1 win and a CL2 placing. The easier meeting and 2kg claim make him a genuine contender. DIRTY HARRY (8) drops from Saturday company after a lacklustre Eagle Farm run, but his previous Gold Coast effort suggests he's better than it appears, making this easier race a chance for him to rebound.
